technical.summary: IBM shows solid bullish structure with price above all key MAs and three white soldiers pattern, but weak trend strength (ADX 17), overbought Williams %R, and negative MACD histogram divergence limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: IBM shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 63 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (VIX-like conditions) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but recent congressional selling by senior Republican McCaul and bearish retail sentiment (49% bearish) create conflicting signals; lack of news data limits conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (39.5), flat yield curve signals recession risk, strong USD pressures multinational earnings, with earnings event 63 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers pattern with price above all major MAs and MACD 8/21/5 crossover up provide classic bullish structure in extreme fear conditions (VIX 39.5), offering contrarian entry near support at 114.66.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend strength (ADX 17), negative MACD histogram divergence, overbought Williams %R, zero insider conviction, high earnings risk in 63 days, and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, strong USD, flat yield curve) create multiple layers of risk that outweigh technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows classic bullish structure (three white soldiers, price above MAs, MACD 8/21/5 crossover) at support in extreme fear conditions, but conviction is undermined by weak trend strength (ADX 17), negative MACD histogram divergence, and zero fundamental/smart money support.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis 39.5, strong USD, flat yield curve) combined with high earnings risk in 63 days and congressional insider selling create binary downside risk that outweighs technical setup quality.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show contrarian opportunity, but fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose entry; debate winner is bear with medium confidence.
decision.portfolio_note: Existing IBM position plus 17 open Information Technology positions (9% sector concentration) argue against adding exposure; skip to preserve capital in unfavourable macro environment.
